userStories.title: Add user-memory triage helper in summarizer + UserFactHandle generator
userStories.description: Pure logic addition: decide which Candidate categories route to user_memory layer vs the existing wiki path. NO consumer wiring in this story. (a) New file `internal/conversation/summarizer/triage.go` with: type `TargetLayer string` const `TargetWiki TargetLayer = "wiki"` and `TargetUserMemory TargetLayer = "user_memory"`. Function `TriageCandidate(c Candidate) TargetLayer` returns TargetUserMemory when `c.Category` is one of `person`, `preference`, `fact`, `todo` (the personal/transient categories per §5.7 user_profile_memory definition); returns TargetWiki when category is `project` or empty (knowledge_wiki layer). (b) Function `UserFactHandle(c Candidate) string` returns a stable handle `user_memory:<sha256(category + normalized_fact)[:16]>` for idempotency. Normalized_fact = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(c.Fact)) collapsing internal whitespace to single space. (c) Tests `triage_test.go`: 7 cases — each of the 5 categories returns expected TargetLayer; empty category returns TargetWiki; identical fact (modulo case+whitespace) produces identical handle. (d) NO changes to applier.go, proposals.go, agent loop, cron, or memoryindex in this story.

userStories.title: Route user-memory candidates to proposed_updates with kind='user_memory'
userStories.description: Make triage LIVE inside the existing summarizer applier path. (a) Locate the applier candidate-handling code in `internal/conversation/summarizer/applier.go` and `proposals.go`. The existing path treats ActionNew/ActionPatch as wiki write. (b) Add a branch BEFORE the wiki resolution: call `TriageCandidate(c)`. If result is TargetUserMemory, route to a new function `createUserMemoryProposal(ctx, store, c)` that inserts a proposed_updates row with kind='user_memory', handle=UserFactHandle(c), action=ActionNew (or ActionPatch if existing user_memory hit detected — see d below), summary=c.Fact, provenance source_turn_ids=c.SourceTurnIDs. (c) Idempotency: if proposed_updates already has a pending row with the same handle (UserFactHandle), skip (skipped++, no duplicate). (d) Existing-fact detection: call `memoryindex.Store.Search(Filter{Kinds: [string(CollectionUserMemory)], ...})` with the fact text as query, threshold 0.85. If hit found, set ActionPatch with TargetSlug=hit.Handle; otherwise ActionNew. (e) NO change to ActionNew/ActionPatch for wiki path — keep existing flow byte-identical. (f) Tests in `applier_test.go` (or `triage_routing_test.go`): 4 cases — Candidate category='preference' routes to proposed_updates kind='user_memory'; Candidate category='project' routes to existing wiki path; double-extract same preference produces 1 proposal not 2 (idempotency); preference matching an existing user_memory entry generates ActionPatch.

userStories.title: Approved user_memory proposals write to compact_memory_documents kind=user_memory
userStories.description: Close the layer movement Phase 7B US-L01 CollectionUserMemory scaffold -> wired. When an operator approves a proposed_updates row with kind='user_memory', a new function in `internal/learning/user_memory_writer.go` (or extension of writer.go from US-N03) writes it as a compact_memory_documents row with kind='user_memory'. (a) New function `WriteApprovedUserFact(ctx context.Context, store memoryindex.Store, proposal Proposal) error`. Builds a memoryindex.Document with Kind=string(memoryindex.CollectionUserMemory), Title=truncate(proposal.Summary, 80), Body=proposal.Summary, Handle=proposal.Handle (already 'user_memory:<sha>:'), Status='active', UpdatedAt=now, ContentHash + EmbeddingModelID + IndexBuildID per Phase 7C pattern (re-use US-M03 freshness wiring). Category=proposal source category (person/preference/fact/todo) stored in Tags. (b) Wire into the applier approval-transition path so when proposal.Kind == 'user_memory' and status flips pending -> approved, WriteApprovedUserFact is invoked. Mirror the US-N03 pattern verbatim. (c) Idempotency: ON CONFLICT(Handle) DO UPDATE Body=excluded.Body, UpdatedAt=excluded.UpdatedAt — so an ActionPatch approval updates the existing row instead of duplicating. (d) Tests `internal/learning/user_memory_writer_test.go` (or extend writer_test.go): 4 cases — approve user_memory proposal: compact_memory_documents row created with kind='user_memory'; double-approve: idempotent (single row); ActionPatch approval updates Body; approve non-user_memory kind: no-op. (e) Verify Phase 7B US-L01 CollectionUserMemory description gets updated in collections.go from 'scaffolded — wired in Phase 7C/7D' to 'wired Phase-O via approved proposed_updates'.

userStories.title: Add recall_user_memory LLM tool + Phase-O closure docs
userStories.description: Make user-memory facts retrievable by the agent + close Phase-O. (a) New file `internal/agent/tools/registry/recall_user_memory.go` with `RecallUserMemoryTool` struct + Definition + Execute. Schema: { 'query': string optional, 'category': string optional (person|preference|fact|todo), 'limit': int default 5 max 20 }. Description copy: 'Surface validated user facts and preferences about the operator (name, location, interests, work context, habits, scheduled todos). Returns approved entries from user memory only — pending proposals are NOT visible here. Use category filter to narrow scope: person (identity), preference (likes/dislikes), fact (general claim), todo (scheduled item).' (b) Execute calls memoryindex.Store.Search with Filter{Kinds: []string{string(memoryindex.CollectionUserMemory)}, Status: 'active', ...} + tag filter if category provided + LIMIT. Format output as markdown list, one line per hit with handle 'user_memory:<sha>' prefix + Phase 7C freshness annotation. (c) Register in `internal/agent/tools/registry/registry.go` alongside recall_operational (US-N04) and search_memory. (d) Test `internal/agent/tools/registry/recall_user_memory_test.go`: 4 cases — empty store: 'no user facts yet'; populated: N hits ordered by recency; filtered by category='preference': only preference rows; filtered by tool_name absent (this is a different tool): N/A skip. (e) Closure docs: create `.planning/deep-refactor/Phase09_Memory_Source_Discipline/subphases/Phase09_user_memory_promotion/` with progress.md (US-O01..O04 SHAs), plan.md (one-pager citing prd.md §5.7 user_profile_memory + Phase-O scope), benchmark.md (actuals). (f) Update prd.md §6.5 Status Checklist (commit c50c9703 added the section): add a new row for Phase-O between 7F and 8 (or below 9 as a sub-phase) showing 'wired KindUserMemory'. (g) Update §7.2 deferrals table: 'Active write-policy (autonomous user/wiki writes, importance scorer, question gate)' Phase 9 row — mark partial completion (preference/fact/todo extraction live; remaining: explicit-intent question gate + memory.user.write capability check, deferred to Phase-Q). (h) Use git add -f for .planning/* paths.
